BiblicalUsage: Peresh is dung, excrement. On the Day of Atonement the bullock and the goat were carried outside the camp, and their skins and flesh and dung were burned with fire. Malachi warns the priests that God will spread dung upon their faces, even the dung of their solemn feasts.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that God calls unclean what is unclean: the dung goes outside the camp, and the corrupt priest wears his own feasts on his face.
